# cubagroceries

## Quick Start

`powershell
.\start.ps1     # Start everything
.\stop.ps1      # Stop everything
.\open.ps1      # Open in VS Code
`

## Project Structure

### Backend (Laravel)
- **Path**: `backend/`
- **URL**: https://cubagroceries.test
- **API**: https://cubagroceries.test/api/v1

### Mobile (Flutter)
- **Path**: `mobile/`
- **Run**: `cd mobile && flutter run`

## Development

Each component runs in its own terminal:
- **Backend**: Already running via Laravel Herd at https://cubagroceries.test
- **Mobile**: `cd mobile && flutter run`
